dossier.scp_unleashed.224.title: Grandfather Clock
dossier.scp_unleashed.224.caption: SCP-224 in its first containment room. The photograph was taken from the corridor, between strokes.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-224 is to be kept in a room of its own behind a closed door. No seat, bed or work station is to be placed anywhere within sight of its face, and personnel are not to linger in its room for any reason.
Any person who hears SCP-224 strike while in its room is to report to medical staff at once and is not to be left alone. %rStaff are to keep their hands free.%r

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-224 is an antique longcase clock a little over two metres tall, in dark polished wood with brass fittings. It has a round ivory dial with two steel hands, and a glazed door in its trunk through which the pendulum and two brass weights can be seen. It keeps perfect time and has never needed winding.
At irregular intervals, usually several minutes apart, SCP-224 strikes. Witnesses agree that it strikes thirteen times, in a deep bell tone far louder than a clock of its size should manage.

Persons who share a room with SCP-224 when it begins to strike, and who are within sight of its face, begin to age. They stoop at once and cannot straighten. Colour drains from what they see, their steps grow slower, and within moments they die of old age.
No medical treatment has slowed the effect.

page.title: Addendum 224-1: Test Log
text: Test 224-03: D-2207 was seated facing SCP-224 and left there. He began to age at the first stroke and was dead of old age shortly after the last.
Test 224-05: D-2210 was seated in the same room, behind a wardrobe. She heard all thirteen strokes and was unaffected.
Test 224-08: D-2214 began to age during a strike. A researcher %rreached into the trunk%r. D-2214 straightened shortly afterwards and recovered fully.

page.title: Addendum 224-2: Maintenance
page.text: SCP-224 has never been heard to strike while its pendulum was at rest. It has never stayed at rest for long.

page.title: Addendum 224-3: Provenance
page.text: SCP-224 was delivered to a reader of this file by a stooped old man in a knitted cardigan, who leaned on a walking stick and said it had been in his family for generations. He seemed relieved to be rid of it. He is not the figure in Foundation dress described in other files.

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp224_clock.1: SCP-224 is an antique longcase clock in dark polished wood with brass fittings. It keeps perfect time and ticks softly.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp224_clock.2: Without warning it strikes, many times over. Those who share a room with it and can see its face when it begins grow old frighteningly fast, and die of old age.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp224_clock.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-224 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal; a kindly old man will bring the clock to the reader.
